design: Deux duels partagés séparés, référence puis variante, chacun OpexAI slot 0 vs AAAHogEx slot 1

policy_comparison.protocol: C66.4 paired policies, separate shared-map duels versus same frozen AAAHogEx

decision_rule.primary_rule: all planned pairs required (1) over 3 years; exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p<0.05; bootstrap percentile 95% CI lower bound > 0; then mean(variant-reference) >= min_useful_primary_delta (absolute, or pct/100 * mean terminal-year reference profit)
decision_rule.value_guard_rule: all 1 reference denominators must be positive; then ratio_of_means(company_value) percent change >= -value_guard_max_loss_pct

line_telemetry.scope: annual December savegame post-processing; no NoAI behavior change
